title: Brown's Navy resignation letter

tellings.quote: Townsend gets a letter telling him he is supposed to transfer his equipment from the University of Philadelphia to the Navy at Norfolk.

plain: In 1942 the scientist Townsend Brown, who worked on electric propulsion ideas, is said to have received a letter ordering him to move his equipment from the University of Philadelphia to the Navy at Norfolk, Virginia, and this is tied to his later letter resigning from the Navy. The researcher Jan Lundquist tells it in a 2024 documentary on Michels's show, working from Brown's resignation letter. It is part of the story of how the Navy took over Brown's work.
